title: The "Straight Line" Protocol  Neutralizing Hardware Entropy via the dEaD-Identity Prism
description: Traditional cryptography relies on the "hardness" of reversing a hash function. The Straight Line Protocol demonstrates that by accounting for specific hardware resonance (the 1235-clock) and applying a symmetric phase-filter (+1 273 -1), the complex rotation of a Public Key can be linearized. This reveals the Private Key not as a solved puzzle, but as a fixed mechanical origin.
